milestone.title: mp test infrastructure — shared fake-herdr harness + deterministic process-group timeout

intent.outcome: Autopilot integration tests share one configurable fake-herdr harness and run subprocess timeout/process-group cases reliably under parallel nextest.

problem.description: Fake-herdr scripts are duplicated across watch tests and the process-group timeout regression is already flaky under parallel CI. Adding spawn, verifier, restart, and E2E coverage on top of those copies would multiply double work and nondeterminism.

in_scope: Shared test helper for herdr version, pane, agent-start, prompt, list, delay, failure, and signal behavior.
Deterministic process-group timeout/kill synchronization without wall-clock races.
Migrate representative existing watch tests before autopilot suites extend the harness.
out_of_scope: Autopilot feature implementation or renaming watch test files.

acceptance_criteria.description: Spawn, prompt, list, version, delayed response, nonzero exit, and signal-ignore behaviors are configured through one shared fake-herdr helper used by representative watch tests.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_herdr_wait --test watch_herdr_start --no-fail-fast
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_herdr_wait --test watch_herdr_start --no-fail-fast exit 0 (51/51 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: The process-group timeout test passes repeatedly under parallel nextest without fixed sleeps and proves descendant processes are terminated.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_bridge_report --no-fail-fast exit 0 (20/20 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Migrated watch tests preserve their prior assertions and no additional ad-hoc fake-herdr script builder is introduced by M210-M226 steps.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_herdr_start --test watch_bridge_report --no-fail-fast
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_herdr_start --test watch_bridge_report --no-fail-fast exit 0 (43/43 pass)

design_decisions.choice: Provide fake herdr as test-only process fixtures under shared test support; production subprocess behavior remains unchanged except deterministic timeout synchronization needed by the test.
design_decisions.rationale: The goal is reuse and reliability, not a second in-process herdr abstraction.

work_packages.name: Shared fake-herdr harness
work_packages.goal: Replace duplicated fake CLI builders with one configurable test primitive.
work_packages.rollback: Revert migrated tests to their prior local fixtures.

work_packages.name: Timeout determinism
work_packages.goal: Make process-group timeout evidence reliable under parallel execution.
work_packages.rollback: Retain retry annotation while restoring previous timeout implementation.

steps.action: Extract configurable fake-herdr helper covering version, pane, agent, prompt, list, delay, failure, and signal modes.
steps.tests: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_herdr_wait --test watch_herdr_start --no-fail-fast
steps.done_when: AC-01 uses one helper across both test targets.

steps.action: Replace sleep-sensitive process-group timeout fixture with readiness synchronization and deterministic descendant assertions.
steps.done_when: AC-02 passes repeated parallel runs without retry dependence.

steps.action: Migrate representative spawn/bridge suites and document reuse requirement for future autopilot tests.
steps.tests: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_herdr_start --test watch_bridge_report --no-fail-fast
steps.done_when: AC-03 preserves assertions and removes local duplicate builders.

verification.evidence: M227 cycle 1: shared fake-herdr harness (crates/mp/tests/common/fake_herdr.rs) with version/pane/agent/prompt/list/delay/failure/signal modes; watch_herdr_wait + watch_herdr_start + watch_bridge_report migrated; deterministic process-group timeout test added (no fixed sleeps, readiness sync via pid file); cargo fmt --check + clippy --no-deps -D warnings pass; AC-01 51/51 + AC-02 20/20 + AC-03 43/43 all pass.
